name: Campaign content MODE gold (350, blind)
instructions: BLIND content-mode gold. Code from the text alone; no model output is shown. The text is the classifier input (up to 3,000 characters; the Text length line says if it is cut). Fields: primary mode (one), all modes present (text, ids separated by |, primary optional -- it is added automatically; blank = primary only), specificity 0-3, notes. Full codebook (verbatim from the workbook codebook sheet; military_bio / attack_target are NOT coded in this chunk). MODE (pick ONE primary): policy_specific = a concrete, checkable proposal or promise (names an instrument, sum, or deadline). issue_position = takes a side on an issue with no concrete instrument ('за справедливые тарифы'). war_stance = СВО/front/veterans/victory as the campaign's identity; (set military_bio=true if it is framed as the candidate's OWN service biography). values_ideas = patriotism, tradition, sovereignty, anti-West framing, history — ideas without a policy. constituency_service = casework/pork: 'добился ремонта двора', fixed a specific local thing, helped a specific person/group. valence_personal = competence, experience, endorsement by a senior figure, biography, likeability — no issue content. mobilization_generic = dates, turnout instructions, ДЭГ how-to, 'поддержите нас' with no substance. attack = negative/critical content about a NAMED opponent, party, or official. not_campaign = not political/campaign content at all (admin notice, unrelated repost, greeting, ad). SPECIFICITY (0-3): 0 = none: no substantive claim at all (pure mobilization/greeting/attack-with-no-content). 1 = vague direction: names a value or direction with no concrete proposal ('нужно поддержать семьи'). 2 = concrete but unquantified: a specific proposal/action with no number or deadline ('построим детскую площадку во дворе'). 3 = quantified with an instrument or deadline: a law, sum, percentage, or date attached ('снизим тариф на 15% с 1 января', 'внесём закон об индексации пенсий на уровень инфляции'). Pointer: campaign2026/validation/DECISION_RULES_PROPOSED_2026-09-28.md (PROPOSED bars, not yet decided).

options.label: issue_position: side on an issue, no instrument
constituency_service: casework / fixed a specific thing
attack: negative on a NAMED opponent/party/official

validation.label: All modes present (ids separated by |; optional)
Notes (optional)
